taskDescription: Match each clinical or histological finding on the left with its corresponding diagnostic investigation image on the right.

cards.imageAlt: Pemphigus vulgaris: flaccid bullae with thin wrinkled roofs and surrounding weeping erosions on the trunk
cards.matchAlt: DIF: intercellular fish-net IgG/C3 pattern outlining keratinocytes, characteristic of pemphigus vulgaris

cards.imageAlt: Bullous pemphigoid: tense dome-shaped bullae on erythematous and urticarial base, intact and firm
cards.matchAlt: DIF: linear IgG/C3 band along the basement membrane zone, characteristic of bullous pemphigoid

cards.imageAlt: H&E histology: suprabasal acantholysis with tombstone basal cells and intra-epidermal cleft in pemphigus vulgaris
cards.matchAlt: Tzanck smear: rounded acantholytic keratinocytes with prominent nuclei, supportive of pemphigus
